question: Owner 2026-10-25: does a richer feature set or LightGBM beat the current logistic entry score?
single_variable: Model (logistic / LightGBM) x feature set (A, A+one group, all, all minus one group), walk-forward by year.
label: win = worst-path near-target net > 0 (10bp slippage on non-target exits)
training: expanding window, fills before 1 January of the test year; LightGBM early-stops on the last 15 percent of training rows by time
thresholds: top 10 / 20 / 40 percent from each fold's training scores
replay: pooled 2025-2026, 1000 USDT, equal 10 percent on top 40 percent and linear 0-25 percent above the 60th training percentile, gross <= 1x, 10 tie orders
